_provenance.data_origin: Analytical: 1D Anderson tight-binding model with uniform random potential. All results derivable from first principles.

_description: Numerical verification of Anderson localization via Lyapunov exponents in 1D disordered systems
_groundspring_question: When does a wave propagate through a disordered medium vs when does noise trap it?

model._description: 1D Anderson tight-binding: H psi(n) = psi(n+1) + psi(n-1) + V(n) psi(n), V(n) uniform in [-W/2, W/2]

analytical_predictions._description: In 1D, ALL states are localized for any W > 0 (Anderson 1958). Localization length xi ~ 96/W^2 at E=0 for small W (Thouless/Derrida-Gardner).
